name: middle-management
description: Shows your Claude Code agents as staff in a pixel-art paper-company office.

commands.title: Middle Management: Open in Editor Tab
Middle Management: Put the office on top
Middle Management: Switch Between View and Manager Mode

enumDescriptions: The full office: hand out tasks, answer knocks, and use the office tools.
Just watch your Claude Code agents work. Only the Front desk (theme, staff, colours) can be opened, and the office never starts Claude Code except for the usage meter.
claudeOffice.mode.description: What the office is for. "view" only shows your agents walking around.

enumDescriptions: Show every live Claude Code session on this machine.
Show only sessions belonging to the current workspace.
claudeOffice.scope.description: Which Claude Code sessions appear in the office.

claudeOffice.companyName.description: Company name on the office wall sign.

claudeOffice.branchName.description: Second line of the wall sign. Leave empty for a one-line sign.

claudeOffice.managerName.description: Name shown for the Regional Manager (you).

claudeOffice.claudePath.description: Path to the claude executable used for tasks given from the office. Leave empty to use the Claude Code extension's bundled `claude`, then `~/.local/bin/claude`, then `claude` on PATH.

enumDescriptions: Check your plan usage every 5 minutes while the office is visible, by briefly starting Claude Code with no prompt. This uses no tokens.
Never start Claude Code to check usage. The office still shows whatever Claude Code has already cached, and the limits reported by tasks you start from the office.
claudeOffice.usageChecks.description: How the office gets your Claude plan usage (the usage meter). "auto" checks every 5 minutes while the office is visible by briefly starting Claude Code with no prompt, using no tokens. "off" never does.

enumDescriptions: Once a day the office asks GitHub whether a newer Middle Management release is out and, if so, shows a memo in the office. It sends no data about you or your projects.
No automatic checks. You can still check from the Front desk's About tab or with the command "Middle Management: Check for Updates".
claudeOffice.updateChecks.description: Whether the office looks for new Middle Management releases. "auto" asks GitHub once a day whether a newer release is out and, if so, shows a memo in the office; it sends no data about you or your projects. "off" never checks by itself; you can still check from the Front desk's About tab or the command "Middle Management: Check for Updates".

claudeOffice.bossQuotes.description: Let the Regional Manager say occasional quotes.

claudeOffice.sendHomeAfter.description: Send idle workers home after this many hours. They walk out of the office and come back when their session has new activity. 0 never sends anyone home automatically.

claudeOffice.themeFile.description: Path to a theme JSON file that names and styles the staff. Leave empty for the built-in office. Run "Middle Management: Create Theme File" to make one.
